description: Find gyms and studios (CrossFit, HYROX, fitness, yoga, pilates, boxing, martial arts, dance) in France and Europe, near a point or by name, city or postcode. Gymmy gyms (onGymmy: true) can be booked; others are listed from OpenStreetMap, not bookable, with a claim link. Use the `gym` value with get_gym, get_schedule, get_prices or start_trial.

activity.description: Only this activity (studios not on Gymmy).

query.description: Gym name, address, district, city or postcode, e.g. 'Lyon', '12 rue Oberkampf Paris' or 'CrossFit Nantes'. Places are geocoded when no lat/lng is given.

radius_km.description: Radius in km, 1 to 50. Default: 10, or fitted to the geocoded place (3 for an address).

name: search_gyms
title: Search gyms and studios
